objective: Build a calibrated supervised classification model to predict student outcome status and segment students into actionable risk tiers for targeted support planning.

tier_1.name: Low Risk / Likely Completer
tier_1.recommended_action: Advanced enrichment, optional peer tutoring leadership, self-directed pacing

tier_2.name: Moderate Risk / Target for Nudge
tier_2.recommended_action: Proactive check-ins, study group matchmaking, milestone reminders, assignment nudges

tier_3.name: High Risk / Early Dropout
tier_3.recommended_action: Urgent advisor outreach, onboarding diagnostic, course prerequisite remediation, technical support

research_questions: What behavioral and engagement patterns reliably predict student completion vs dropout?
How accurately can candidate models distinguish completers from non-completers in an imbalanced cohort?
Are the predicted probabilities well-calibrated for reliable risk-tier segmentation?
Does the model maintain fair and equitable performance across demographic subgroups?
How can predicted probabilities be translated into targeted, non-punitive student support interventions?

success_criteria.calibration: Brier score <= 0.05 and verified empirical calibration across deciles
success_criteria.anti_leakage: Strict isolation of all outcome variables (certified, grade, incomplete_flag, explored) from features X; zero leakage across train/validation/test splits.
success_criteria.fairness: Equal opportunity and subgroup parity audits across gender, education, and geography
success_criteria.actionability: Clear translation of probabilities into 3 operational support tiers

governance.intended_use: Proactive educational assistance, early nudges, prerequisite review
governance.prohibited_use: Automated exclusion, punitive course dropping, discriminatory admission decisions

supported_new_data: Later MOOC cohorts with identical non-outcome feature definitions and raw person-course schema.
incompatible_data_policy: If feature definitions or course structures change, retraining via Step 2 is mandatory.
